verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.70
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.70

verses.pali: 7. Yamakavagga
verses.english: 7. Pairs

verses.pali: Dutiyakathāvatthusutta
verses.english: Topics of Discussion (2nd)

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṁ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā upaṭṭhānasālāyaṁ sannisinnā sannipatitā anekavihitaṁ tiracchānakathaṁ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: Now at that time, after the meal, on return from almsround, several mendicants sat together in the assembly hall.

verses.pali: rājakathaṁ corakathaṁ mahāmattakathaṁ …pe… itibhavābhavakathaṁ iti vāti.
verses.english: They engaged in all kinds of low talk, such as talk about kings, bandits, and chief ministers; talk about armies, threats, and wars; talk about food, drink, clothes, and beds; talk about garlands and fragrances; talk about family, vehicles, villages, towns, cities, and nations; talk about women and heroes; street talk and well talk; talk about the departed; miscellaneous talk; tales of land and sea; and talk about being reborn in this or that state of existence.

verses.pali: “Dasayimāni, bhikkhave, pāsaṁsāni ṭhānāni.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are ten grounds for praise.

verses.pali: Katamāni dasa?
verses.english: What ten?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu attanā ca appiccho hoti, appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant personally has few wishes, and speaks to the mendicants on having few wishes.

verses.pali: ‘Appiccho bhikkhu appicchakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca santuṭṭho hoti, santuṭṭhikathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is content, and speaks to the mendicants on contentment.

verses.pali: ‘Santuṭṭho bhikkhu santuṭṭhikathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca pavivitto hoti, pavivekakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is secluded, and speaks to the mendicants on seclusion.

verses.pali: ‘Pavivitto bhikkhu pavivekakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca asaṁsaṭṭho hoti, asaṁsaṭṭhakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally doesn’t mix closely with others, and speaks to the mendicants on not mixing closely with others.

verses.pali: ‘Asaṁsaṭṭho bhikkhu asaṁsaṭṭhakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca āraddhavīriyo hoti, vīriyārambhakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is energetic, and speaks to the mendicants on rousing energy.

verses.pali: ‘Āraddhavīriyo bhikkhu vīriyārambhakathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is accomplished in ethics, and speaks to the mendicants on being accomplished in ethics.

verses.pali: ‘Sīlasampanno bhikkhu sīlasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti, samādhisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is accomplished in immersion, and speaks to the mendicants on being accomplished in immersion.

verses.pali: ‘Samādhisampanno bhikkhu samādhisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, paññāsampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is accomplished in wisdom, and speaks to the mendicants on being accomplished in wisdom.

verses.pali: ‘Paññāsampanno bhikkhu paññāsampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is accomplished in freedom, and speaks to the mendicants on being accomplished in freedom.

verses.pali: ‘Vimuttisampanno bhikkhu vimuttisampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā hoti.
verses.english: A mendicant personally is accomplished in the knowledge and vision of freedom, and speaks to the mendicants on being accomplished in the knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: ‘Vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno bhikkhu vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañca bhikkhūnaṁ kattā’ti pāsaṁsametaṁ ṭhānaṁ.
verses.english: This is a ground for praise.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa pāsaṁsāni ṭhānānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten grounds for praise.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Yamakavaggo dutiyo.
Tassuddānaṁ
Avijjā taṇhā niṭṭhā ca,
avecca dve sukhāni ca;
Naḷakapāne dve vuttā,
kathāvatthūpare duveti.
